provenance.prompt:
Edit the attached transparent Kraken pass sprite sheet. Preserve its exact 3-column by 2-row reading order, canvas, alpha background, pixel-art style, original scale, body proportions, anatomy, colors, uniform, face, short auburn hair, pointed elf ear, copper amulet, and all poses except the specifically identified frame below.

Correct only frame 2 (top row, third cell). It must be a clear pre-release chest gather, not an extended pass: both elbows visibly bent close to the ribs; both hands open and clearly separated at chest height with an obvious space where the separate basketball will be rendered; shoulders and torso turned toward target, knees flexed. Do not reach the hands forward or extend either arm in this cell. Frame 2 is the last held-ball pose before the canonical frame 3 release anchor at tick 5.

Preserve frame 3 (bottom row, first cell) as the unmistakable chest-pass release beginning at tick 5, with a small forward step and both arms extended toward target. Preserve frame 4 (bottom row, second cell) as the distinct follow-through and frame 5 (bottom row, third cell) as recovery. Keep frames 0 and 1 as the ready and preparation poses. Do not draw a basketball or any ball-shaped object in any frame.

Keep the same exact Kraken identity in every frame: natural-skinned athletic male elf, short auburn hair, pointed ears, copper amulet, burgundy Vesper Harbor uniform with copper/gold trim, wrist details, matching shorts and shoes. Do not redesign or alter his face, hair, anatomy, kit, palette, or character. Preserve complete bodies and transparent space around each pose. No gridlines, labels, objects, extra fingers, cropped limbs, separated accessories, or detached pixels. Only adjust frame 2's arm pose enough to read as a held ball gather immediately before frame 3's release.
